title: Page 1
content_zh:
鹅毛大雪彷佛永远不会停止，八岁的汪袭绿小小的身子被裹在滚着白狐狸毛的大氅之中，头上也戴着一顶毛绒绒的狐狸毛帽，整个人只有那张娇俏的脸蛋是露出来的，那一双骨碌碌的大眼转啊转的，模样精灵可爱。
她想，若不是怕她瞧不着路摔着了，只怕乳母恨不得能将她的脸也全都遮起来。
其实她对于被裹了这一身不是没有抗议过，可是乳母听了她那愤愤的话语，只是淡淡的说道—“夫人这几日身子骨可不好，要是大小姐着凉了，只怕又要让夫人日夜挂心了。”
听到这样的话，汪袭绿可不敢再有什么抱怨了，这半年来，娘亲的身子骨益发不好了，她不想再让娘亲担心。
虽然长辈们什么都没告诉她，可是每回从他们瞧见她时摇头又叹气的模样，她就可以猜出个七八分。
想到这里，汪袭绿原本看到下雪时兴奋的心情已经完全消失，取而代之的是那一抹沉甸甸的思绪，就连她迈出去的步子也没了她这年纪该有的轻快。
走过了抄手游廊，再走过蜿蜒小径，经过了无数个脸颊被冻得红通通的扫雪丫鬟，汪袭绿终于瞧着了娘亲住的明月院。
怎料她人才刚走近，便听到屋子里传来几声重重的咳嗽声，撕心裂肺一般，让她心惊不已，接着，她听到她爹最近的新宠那娇滴滴的嗓音—“夫人……夫人……你还好吧？”
问这样的问题并不算突兀，可若是那娇嗲甜腻的嗓音带着浓得掩不住的幸灾乐祸时，那可就有点古怪了。
“骆姨娘，夫人该服药了。”
汪袭绿听出这是娘亲身边最得力的丫鬟杏花的声音。
杏花脆生生的音调里有着极力压抑的怒气，虽然侍妾的身分并没有比丫鬟高多少，但也不是她可以得罪的。
也不知道到底是骆姨娘听不懂杏花赶人的暗示，还是骆姨娘压根就是故意的，她兴致高昂的说道：“该服药了吗？拿来，我来伺候夫人吧。”
“奴婢瞧这天色，老爷只怕就要下朝回来了，要是知道姨娘做了这等下人的粗活，还指不定多心疼呢！”杏花这话几乎是从牙缝里挤出来的，还带着讽刺。
骆姨娘不屑的道：“杏花啊，我知道你是夫人身旁有脸面的丫鬟，可你相不相信，只要我和老爷说几句话，你就会被立刻发卖出去或许配给人。”
“你……”杏花的一张俏脸儿被这话噎得霎时刷白，不敢再吭一声，紧咬着薄唇，眸中含怒地看着一脸得意的骆姨娘。
无论是屋子里头的人，包括汪夫人和杏花，还是冷着脸站在外面的汪袭绿，众人心里都很清楚，只消骆姨娘几句枕畔细语，宠妾灭妻的老爷绝对会毫不犹豫地照做。
在一阵窒人的寂静后，屋子里头响起的是娘亲虚弱却带着一丝冷厉的嗓音。
“杏花，跪下向骆姨娘磕头。”
听到娘亲这么说，汪袭绿再也忍不住了，没等羞怒不已的杏花跪下，她直接让跟在后头的红串掀了帘子进了里屋。

“娘，我怎么听说有人要将杏花姊姊发卖啊？”
娇嫩的声音，再配上还有些孩子气的脸庞，汪袭绿虽然模样天真，可却不是真的天真，这一年多来，娘亲的缠绵病榻、姨娘的无理争宠，让她这个原也是千娇百宠的千金小姐也被迫提早长大懂事。
汪袭绿来到床前，不意外的看到娘亲苍白的脸上闪现着深深的愤恨与气怒。
“娘，你安心歇息，我不会让人欺负杏花姊姊的，我想，以我这个嫡出大小姐的身分，要保住一个下人，应该不是难事吧？”话落，汪袭绿抬头看向穿得像是只彩蝶的骆姨娘，清亮的眼神带着一抹浑然天成的犀利与气势。“骆姨娘，你说是吧？”
对汪袭绿来说，骆姨娘甚至算不得正经的长辈，不过是个恃宠而骄的下人罢了，或许娘亲因为父亲而忌惮她，或许杏花因为她能在父亲面前说上话而惧怕她，可是她不怕。
就算她爹能眼睁睁看着骆姨娘欺到娘亲这个正室的头上，可至少她那个把规矩挂在嘴边的祖母不会放任骆姨娘如此恣意妄为。
“这……”趾高气扬的骆姨娘心中自是气怒，但到底还是不敢真的招惹眼前这个嫡出的大小姐。
她的心里很清楚，她之所以可以爬到夫人的头上，那是因为老爷对夫人已经厌弃，可是他却不可能厌弃自己的孩子。
反正这么多时日都忍了，只等眼前这个病恹恹的女人一断气，她再向老爷吹吹枕边风儿，这个丁点大的小丫头还不是任她拿捏吗？
“自然是的，大小姐想要保谁，自然可以保谁。”骆姨娘堆起讨好的笑容道。
汪袭绿来了，她讨不了便宜，便借口自己的院子里还有事，匆匆告退。
见她识趣的离去，汪袭绿便知道这个女人不光有美貌，而且还不蠢，难怪几次交锋，落在下风的总是娘亲。
“女儿，都是娘没用，才让你小小年纪便遭到这样的欺侮……”汪夫人才说了几句，眼泪便像断了线的珍珠般淌落。
“娘，很多时候哭是没用的，你若真为女儿好，就该好好保养身子，成为女儿的依靠。”
这段时日，汪袭绿已经领略了许多没有亲娘疼惜的滋味了，她是年纪小，但这并不代表她什么都不懂。
这段时日她眼看着父亲在那些小妾的挑拨下，日渐疏离她娘，也注意到父亲看着娘亲的目光由敬重到嫌弃，更看着亲娘的伤心一天重过一天，终于沉痾不起，若是再这样下去，娘亲很快就会将命熬没了。
若是娘亲可以不看着爹，只看着她，是不是就能解开心结呢？
汪袭绿的脑海中倏地闪过这样的念头，下一瞬，她望着娘亲苍白的脸庞说道：“母亲，咱们不理她们，只咱们俩一起生活，好吗？咱们搬去庄子住，眼不见心不烦。”
“傻瓜，哪有那么简单的。”尽管已经虚弱得几乎没有力气，但汪夫人还是咬牙抬起手，握住了女儿的小手，涩然道：“嫁了人，怎能说离家就离家呢？”
“既然咱们不能走，那咱们就把宅子里那些女人都赶走吧！”汪袭绿睁着大眼，很认真的说道：“娘，你要看着，看着女儿怎么把她们都赶走……”

“赶不走的……就算赶走了她们，也还是会有别人，这都是女人的命，都是命……”汪夫人呢喃似的说着，然而不过说了这么几句话，却几乎耗尽了她所有的精神，她话都还没说完，眼皮已经疲累的阖上。
望着又昏睡过去的娘亲，汪袭绿的眼中蓦地闪过一丝冷意，喃喃的说道：“娘，我不认命，你也不要认命……”
怎料当晚汪夫人于睡梦中离世，而汪袭绿也在夜半时分被人从被窝中掏出来，让丫鬟们伺候着换了一身白衣素缟。
在仆妇们一片的哀戚神色之中，汪袭绿清清楚楚听到骆姨娘那张狂的笑声从她的院子里传了出来，可是却没有任何人喝止，甚至连她的父亲都没有。
她直勾勾的看着躺在棺材里头的娘亲，小嘴儿喃喃地说道：“我不认命……不认命……此生我绝不认命！”
第1章(1)
汪袭绿安静的坐在屋里的椅子上，动也不动，原本丰润的红唇透着一股子的白，原本总是白里透红的双颊如今更是没有一点血色。
即便如此，她仍像一只漂亮细致的瓷娃娃，散发着浑然天成的美艳。
content_en:
The heavy snow seemed to never stop. Eight-year-old Wang Xilu's small body was wrapped in a large cloak rolled with white fox fur, and he also wore a fluffy fox fur hat on his head. Only his pretty face was exposed, and his big bony eyes rolled around, making him look cute and cute.
She thought, if she wasn't afraid that she wouldn't be able to see the road and fall down, the wet nurse would have wished she could have covered her face as well.
In fact, she had not protested about being wrapped up, but after hearing her angry words, the wet nurse just said lightly - "Madam has not been in good health these days. If the eldest lady catches a cold, I am afraid that Madam will have to worry about it day and night."
Hearing this, Wang Xilu didn't dare to complain anymore. In the past six months, her mother's body and bones had become worse and worse, and she didn't want to worry her mother anymore.
Although the elders didn't tell her anything, she could guess a good deal from the way they shook their heads and sighed every time they saw her.
Thinking of this, Wang Xilu's original excitement when she saw the snow had completely disappeared, replaced by that heavy thought, and even her steps were no longer as brisk as she should have been at her age.
After walking through the corridor, then walking along the winding path, and passing countless snow-sweeping maids whose cheeks were red from the cold, Wang Lu finally looked at Mingyue Yuan where her mother lived.
Unexpectedly, as soon as she approached, she heard several heavy coughs coming from the house, which were heartbreaking and frightening. Then, she heard the delicate voice of her father's latest favorite - "Madam... Madam... are you okay?"
It's not too out of the ordinary to ask such a question, but it would be a bit weird if that coquettish and sweet voice was filled with a tone of gloating that couldn't be concealed.
"Aunt Luo, it's time for Madam to take her medicine."
Wang Xilu recognized the voice of Xinghua, the most capable maid around her mother.
Xinghua's brittle tone contained the anger she was trying to suppress. Although the concubine's status was not much higher than that of the maid, she was not someone she could offend.
I don't know if Aunt Luo didn't understand Xinghua's hint of chasing people away, or if Aunt Luo did it on purpose. She said in high spirits: "Is it time to take the medicine? Here, I will take care of Madam."
"My dear, look at the weather. I'm afraid I'm going back to court soon. If I knew my aunt had done such a menial job for a servant, I'd be very distressed!"
Aunt Luo said disdainfully: "Xinghua, I know you are a respectable maid beside Madam, but do you believe that as long as I say a few words to the master, you will be sold out or given to someone else immediately?"
"You..." Xinghua's pretty face turned white immediately after being choked by these words. She didn't dare to say another word. She bit her thin lips tightly and looked at Aunt Luo who looked proud with anger in her eyes.
Whether it was the people in the room, including Mrs. Wang and Xinghua, or Wang Xilu who was standing outside with a cold face, everyone knew very well that as long as Aunt Luo whispered a few words from her pillow, the man who spoiled his concubine and killed his wife would definitely do it without hesitation.
After a period of suffocating silence, my mother's weak but cold voice sounded in the room.
"Xinghua, kneel down and kowtow to Aunt Luo."
Hearing what her mother said, Wang Xilu couldn't bear it any longer. Before Xinghua, who was filled with shame and anger, knelt down, she let Hong Chuan, who was following behind, lift the curtain and enter the back room.
"Mom, why did I hear that someone wanted to sell Sister Xinghua?"
With a delicate voice and a childish face, although Wang Xilu looks innocent, she is not really innocent. For more than a year, her mother's lingering on the sickbed and her aunt's unreasonable competition for favor have forced her, a rich young lady who was also pampered and pampered, to grow up and become sensible early.
When Wang Xilu came to the bed, he was not surprised to see deep resentment and anger flashing on his mother's pale face.
"mother, you can rest in peace, I won’t let anyone bully Sister Xinghua. I think, as a legitimate eldest lady, it shouldn’t be difficult to keep a servant, right? "After saying this, Wang Xilu raised his head and looked at Aunt Luo, who was dressed like a colorful butterfly. Her clear eyes were full of natural sharpness and momentum. "Aunt Luo, do you think so? "
To Wang Xilu, Aunt Luo was not even a serious elder, but just a pampered and arrogant servant. Maybe her mother was afraid of her because of her father, or maybe Xinghua was afraid of her because she could speak in front of her father, but she was not afraid.
Even if her father could watch Aunt Luo bully her mother, the head of the family, at least her grandmother, who always talked about rules, would not let Aunt Luo act so wantonly.
"This..." The arrogant Aunt Luo was angry, but she still didn't dare to provoke the eldest daughter in front of her.
She knew very well in her heart that the reason why she could climb over the madam's head was because the master had already disliked the madam, but it was impossible for him to dislike his own child.
Anyway, I have endured it for so long, and I just want to wait for the sick woman in front of me to die, and then she will blow my pillow to the master. Isn't this little girl just at her disposal?
"Of course, yes, the eldest lady can protect whoever she wants to protect. "Aunt Luo put on a flattering smile and said.
When Wang Xilu came, she couldn't get any advantage, so she excused herself and left in a hurry on the pretext that she had something to do in her yard.
Seeing her leaving in a sensible manner, Wang Xilu knew that this woman was not only beautiful, but also not stupid. No wonder her mother always fell at the disadvantage during several confrontations.
"Daughter, it's all because of your useless mother that you were bullied like this at such a young age..." Mrs. Wang only said a few words before her tears fell down like broken pearls.
"Mom, crying is useless most of the time. If you are really good for your daughter, you should take good care of yourself and become her daughter's support. "
During this period of time, Wang Xilu has experienced a lot of what it's like to not have the love of her own mother. She is young, but this does not mean that she does not understand anything.
During this period, she watched her father gradually alienate her mother due to the instigation of those concubines. She also noticed that the way her father looked at her mother changed from respect to disgust. She also watched her mother become more and more sad day by day, and finally became seriously ill. If this continued, her mother would soon die.
If mother can stop looking at father and only look at her, can her heart be relieved?
Such thoughts flashed through Wang Xilu's mind. The next moment, she looked at her mother's pale face and said, "Mom, let's ignore them and just the two of us live together, okay? Let's move to Zhuangzi, out of sight and out of mind. "
"Fool, it's not that simple. "Although she was so weak that she had almost no strength, Mrs. Wang still gritted her teeth and raised her hand, held her daughter's little hand, and said solemnly: "How can you leave home when you are married? "
"Since we can't leave, let's get rid of all those women in the house! "Wang Xilu opened his eyes wide and said seriously: "Mom, you have to watch and see how my daughter drives them away..."
"Those who can't be driven away... Even if we drive them away, there will still be others. This is a woman's life, it's all life..." Mrs. Wang muttered, but after saying only a few words, she almost exhausted all her energy. Before she could finish speaking, her eyelids were already closed tiredly.
Looking at his mother who had fallen asleep again, a coldness suddenly flashed across Wang Xilu's eyes, and he murmured: "Mom, I don't accept my fate, and you don't accept your fate either..."
Unexpectedly, Mrs. Wang passed away in her sleep that night, and Wang Xilu was taken out of the bed in the middle of the night and asked to be served by the maids and changed into white clothes.
Amid the mournful looks on the servants' faces, Wang Xilu clearly heard Aunt Luo's mad laughter coming from her courtyard.The news came out, but no one stopped her, not even her father.
She looked straight at her mother lying in the coffin and murmured: "I don't accept my fate...I don't accept my fate...I will never accept my fate in this life!"
Chapter 1(1)
Wang Xilu sat quietly on the chair in the room, motionless. Her originally plump red lips showed a hint of white, and her cheeks, which were always white and rosy, now had no color at all.
Even so, she is still like a beautiful and delicate porcelain doll, exuding natural beauty.
